name: get-all-urls-from-a-website-sitemap
title: Get all URLs from a website's sitemap
seoTitle: Get every URL from a website's XML sitemap
seoDescription: Discover a site's sitemap via robots.txt and common paths, walk sitemap indexes and gzip files, and export every URL with lastmod to CSV.
description: Discover a website's sitemap through robots.txt and common locations, walk nested sitemap indexes and gzip files, and export every URL with its lastmod date. Paste a homepage or a sitemap URL.

name: list-blog-post-urls-from-a-sitemap
title: List only blog post URLs from a sitemap
seoTitle: Extract only blog post URLs from a sitemap
seoDescription: Filter sitemap URLs with include and exclude patterns, for example only /blog/ paths and no tag or author pages, for content audits and crawls.
description: Filter sitemap URLs with include and exclude patterns, here keeping only blog posts and dropping tag and author pages, to seed content audits, crawlers or migration checklists.

name: audit-a-sitemap-index-tree
title: Audit a site's sitemap index tree
seoTitle: List every sitemap file in a sitemap index (audit mode)
seoDescription: List the sitemap files a site exposes, with URL counts and nesting depth, without extracting the URLs themselves. Cheap way to size a crawl.
description: List all sitemap files a site exposes, including nested indexes and gzip files, with URL counts and depth, without extracting the page URLs. A cheap way to size a crawl or audit sitemap hygiene on large publishers.

name: recently-updated-pages-from-sitemap-lastmod
title: Recently updated pages from sitemap lastmod
seoTitle: Find recently updated pages using sitemap lastmod dates
seoDescription: Extract URLs with their lastmod, changefreq and priority so you can sort by date and find what a site changed recently.
description: Extract URLs with their lastmod, changefreq and priority values so the dataset can be sorted by date to find what a site changed recently, for monitoring competitors or re-crawling only fresh pages.
